jobs.title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
jobs.description: The role As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you ll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you ll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh s brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate. Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you ll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You ll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there s room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets. What You ll Do Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout. Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations. Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn t possible. Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks. Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Data Scientist | Semiconductor Metrology Abingdon, UK Reward and Benefits £42,000 - £55,000 (depending on experience) Annual bonus, 3x salary death in service benefit and private health care BUPA, EMI Share scheme. If you are a Data Scientist who enjoys turning instrument data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and help prove the analysis methods behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems. We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Data Scientist to join our new Data Science team in the Technology department, reporting to the Data Science Lead and working closely with our Modelling Scientist. You will generate and curate data, develop and test new algorithms, and benchmark them against what the instrument can physically deliver. When a method proves itself, you will package it for the Data Analysis team in Engineering, who turn it into robust product software. You will work with real customer use cases and wafer data from Applications Development, and proof-of-concept data from R&D. We are an AI-first team, so you will use AI tools every day, while checking carefully what they produce. If your passion is speed, evidence and finding out what the data can really tell you, we’d love to hear from you. What you’ll be doing Generate synthetic data, and build and maintain the demo and performance data libraries Analyse instrument data to quantify noise and limitations, and help establish the information limit, meaning what is physically extractable from the instrument Develop and test new algorithms and analysis methods (for example PCA, percentile methods and machine learning) on real and synthetic data Benchmark methods against the information limit: achievable performance, measurement uncertainty, gauge R&R and drift contributors Write clean, reproducible prototype code with test data and expected performance, ready to hand over to Data Analysis, and build analysis tools used across the Technology department Use AI

jobs.description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world s most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World s Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases.
